$comment: Global sourcing registry for independent contest catalog construction. Every contest in the catalog must trace to a sponsor on this list. Organizations are grouped by tier: work top-down. URLs marked verified:true were confirmed during research; the rest are the organization's known primary domain and should be confirmed on first use.
sourcing_rule: NEVER populate a contest record from an aggregator. Only from the sponsoring organization's own published rules. If the sponsor's page cannot be found, the record stays unverified and does not ship.

known_derived_sources.name: ARRL Contest Corral (monthly PDF)
known_derived_sources.reason: ARRL states the Corral is generated from data maintained on the WA7BNM Contest Calendar and extracted for QST. It is downstream of contestcalendar.com, not an independent compilation.

known_derived_sources.name: SM3CER Contest Service
known_derived_sources.reason: Third-party aggregator republishing sponsors' rules. Use it to FIND a sponsor's own site if needed, then source from the sponsor directly.

known_derived_sources.name: DXZone / hamradioworld / club news posts
known_derived_sources.reason: Downstream aggregators. Useful only for locating a sponsor's primary domain.

tier_5_qso_parties.notes: Roughly 45 US state QSO parties plus Canadian provincial parties. Each has its own sponsoring club and site. The State QSO Party Challenge (stateqsoparty.com) indexes them but is itself an aggregator -- use it only to locate sponsors, then source from each sponsor directly. Florida QSO Party is local priority for GCCC.

engine_gaps.detail: CWops CWT runs weekly; SKCC Sprint, ARS Spartan Sprint, 4SQRP Second Sunday Sprint and NCCC Sprint run monthly. The current engine produces at most one occurrence per contest per year.
engine_gaps.fix: Add rule types 'weekly' {weekday, times[]} and 'monthly_nth_weekday' {n, weekday}, and change expand() to return a LIST of occurrences rather than a single one. This materially increases catalog coverage -- these high-frequency contests are a large share of WA7BNM's ~500 entries.

engine_gaps.detail: ARRL 10 GHz has two rounds; Stew Perry runs three or four times a year; EME has multiple weekends.
engine_gaps.fix: Currently handled by separate records per leg, which works but duplicates metadata. Consider a 'legs' array on one record.

engine_gaps.detail: ARRL EME dates are set annually based on lunar conditions and have no fixed rule.
engine_gaps.fix: Add rule type 'manual' with an explicit date table, flagged in the UI as 'confirm with sponsor'.

engine_gaps.detail: ARRL 10 GHz runs on local time, not UTC. Flagged via local_time:true but not yet resolved per timezone.
engine_gaps.fix: Render local-time contests as a per-timezone offset at display time rather than storing a fixed UTC instant.

estimated_scope.note: Reaching WA7BNM's ~500 requires the long tail of small regional and weekly events, which is where the remaining effort compounds. 310 well-sourced contests covers essentially everything an active contester would ever enter.
